id.description: The identifier of the network device.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the network device.

name.description: The full name of the network device.

objectType.description:
The type of this network device as defined by the `objectTypeEnumSet`.

The values for this property come from the `objectTypeEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `objectTypeEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/objectTypeEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

objectTypeVersion.description: The version of `objectType` that is used for this object.

productVersion.description: The product version of the object.

description.description: The description for the network device.

firmwareVersion.description: The firmware version for the network device. This property will be an empty string "" if the device does not support a firmware version.

objectCategory.description:
The authorization category for the network device.

The values for this property come from the `objectCategoryEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `objectCategoryEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/objectCategoryEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

timeZone.description:
The time zone for the network device. This property will be `null` if the device does not support a time zone.

The values for this property come from the `timeZoneEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `timeZoneEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/timeZoneEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

self.description: The link to the network device.

parentUrl.description: A link to the network device that is the parent of this network device.

networkDevicesUrl.description: A link to the network devices that are children of this network device.

equipmentUrl.description: A link to the equipment instances hosted by this network device.

spacesUrl.description: A link to the spaces that are served by this network device.

objectsUrl.description: A link to the objects contained within this network device.

trendedAttributesUrl.description: A link to the attributes on this network device for which samples are available.

alarmsUrl.description: A link to the alarms available for this network device.

allowHttp.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ Indicates if the network device allows HTTP communication. This property will be `false` if the device has blocked the HTTP port (port 80).

jciIpCommMode.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The BACnet IP communication mode for the network device. The values for this property come from the `ipCommModeEnumSet` enumeration. Find the definition of `ipCommModeEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/ipCommModeEnumSet`. **See also:** * [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

ipAddress.description: The IPv4 address of the network device. This will be `null` if the device does not support an IP address.

deviceIpv6Address.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The IPv6 address of the network device. This will be `null` if the device does not support an IPv6 address.

certificateExpirationDate.description:
The expiration date & time of the device's HTTPS certificate. This will
be `null` if the device does not support HTTPS certificates or there is
no certificate present.

pairing.description: Provides indicators to the pairing capabilities of the network device.

supported.description: Indicates if the device supports the pairing operation.

paired.description: Indicates if the device has been authenticated with the site director. This property will always be `false` if `supported` is `false`.

ethernetMacAddress.description: RELEASE: 16.0\ The MAC address of the network device.

modelName.description: RELEASE: 16.0\ The model name of the network device.
